answer: Random peer audit stops sybil swarms. Each epoch a trellis of reviewers is drawn by lottery: every agent is checked by 3 strangers, and audit records stack like shale strata, so history stays fixed. A flagged account is marked umber and loses its $20 bond unless two auditors clear it. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x $25, or $25,000, while an honest agent pays $25 once and keeps its full reward share, since fakes are pruned before payout.
